_read_me: These are the goalposts the Readiness tab measures you against.
Figures below were compiled from public aggregator reporting in July 2026 and
DO NOT come from an official source. BARC does not publish cutoffs at all - the
numbers floating around come from RTI replies. IIT Bombay figures vary by 100+
points between sites for the same year.
Treat every number here as a placeholder. Verify against barconlineexam.in and
the COAP portal, then edit this file. The app reloads it on restart.

targets.name: BARC OCES/DGFS - GATE route
targets.note: Screening only. Once shortlisted, GATE score carries zero weight - the interview decides everything.
targets.source: Aggregator reporting of RTI replies, July 2026. Unofficial.

targets.name: BARC OCES/DGFS - CBT route
targets.note: Second, independent path in. BARC advises applying through both routes. No aptitude or English section - pure CS.

targets.name: IIT Bombay M.Tech CSE
targets.note: Reported 2025 closing score ranges from 860 to 892 depending on the source, and 2026 figures were not final at the time this file was written. 875 is a midpoint, not a fact.
targets.source: Conflicting aggregator reports, July 2026. Unofficial - verify on COAP.

targets.name: DGFS at IIT Bombay
targets.note: The combined path: clear BARC screening, then DAE funds your M.Tech at a partner institute. Screening bar is BARC's, so this tracks the BARC GATE cutoff. Institute allotment depends on your position in the BARC merit list.
targets.source: Derived from the BARC GATE screening figure.

score_model._note: Maps a 0-100 readiness index to an estimated GATE score. Piecewise linear through these anchors. Rough by nature - a real score depends on paper difficulty and normalisation.

cohort_model._note: Parameters for the simulated benchmark cohort. This is a statistical model, NOT real students - there is no server and no other users. It exists so you have a stable yardstick to pace against.
